questions.question: Try the fix again here anyway?

options.label: Start over (Recommended)
options.description: You go back to before the first try (/rewind, or /clear when the line above names only /clear) and re-prompt with what the attempts showed, so the fix starts clean, without the failed attempts.

options.label: Yes
options.description: I make the fix again in this conversation; the failed attempts stay in it, and every turn re-reads them.

options.label: No
options.description: I leave the fix as it is and make no new try.
